summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by INLIF Limited, a Cayman Islands exempted company listed on NASDAQ, rescheduling its extraordinary general meeting from August 17, 2026 to September 8, 2026. The board approved revised proposals including a share capital increase from US$350,000 to US$2.72 billion, which would authorize up to 8 billion Class A and 500 million Class B ordinary shares. The filing also includes adoption of amended memorandum and articles of association. This is an administrative meeting-notice update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. The rescheduled meeting and revised proposals do not constitute a classified special situation; the item is routine corporate governance housekeeping.
